remarks: All 6 verifiedSources beyond the two seed URLs were discovered by inspecting the actual hyperlinks (href attributes) present in the already-verified ofris.hp.gov.in home page and FAQ.pdf, not from WebSearch snippets — each was then independently curl-fetched and content-inspected per the spec, so they meet the 'personally visited and confirmed' bar even though the discovery method differed from search.

Three otherwise-plausible .gov.in/.nic.in hosts (rajpatrahimachal.nic.in, labour.hp.gov.in, indiacode.nic.in) could not be reached from this session despite multiple retries with the proxy's CA bundle; the proxy's own failure log shows many other state government hosts (e.g. hrylabour.gov.in, sewasetu.assam.gov.in, services.india.gov.in) failing in the same window, suggesting this may be a broader network/policy condition for this session rather than those specific government sites being down — but per the spec's rule, they were excluded rather than guessed at.

The OFRIS portal's own official FAQ PDF (now itself a verified source) contains three stale internal links to a retired himachal.nic.in URL scheme and to a dead legacy admis.hp.nic.in domain; these were checked and excluded rather than cited, since the department has since migrated the whole system to ofris.hp.gov.in.

NSWS (nsws.gov.in) was verified only at its central homepage level; no specific Himachal-Pradesh-factory-license service subpage on NSWS could be found or verified — the platform's service-specific pages appear to require an authenticated session/search rather than being reachable via a direct public URL, so only the homepage is listed, with that caveat.

No standalone, separately-hosted PDF of the Himachal Pradesh Factories Rules, 1950 (or its 2024/2025 amendments) could be found on a .gov.in/.nic.in domain and verified this session; all search hits for the rules text pointed to private compliance/newsletter sites (comply4hr, simpliance, teamleaseregtech, ksandk, legalitysimplified, lexplosion, greythr), which the spec explicitly excludes as non-government aggregators.
